title: 卷一江湖少年 第十七章壁中洞天卷一江湖少年 第十八章前朝遗藏
slug: 梦启东梁第一四零六章蛛丝有毒

壁中洞天
映霞岛上，随着海面上的圆月越升越高，隋缘猛然从石亭的扶栏上做了起来，双眼死死盯着一侧的石壁，面上满是惊疑不定的神色。
隋缘可以确定，刚刚有一道人影从石壁上的石亭内跃下，这道人影并没有落在地面上，而是在下落到中途的时候诡异的消失不见。
‘这石壁上有古怪！
‘心中闪过这个念头，隋缘心中不可遏制的生出了想要前往一探究竟的念头。
‘以那人的身手，我肯定不是他的对手，只要小心一些，应当没什么问题！
‘小乞丐心中没有惧怕这个说法，打定了主意，环顾四周确认没有人发现自己，这才蹑手蹑脚的向石壁处走去。
在竹林中穿行了将近半个时辰，当隋缘气喘吁吁的来到石壁下面的时候，却发现这里竟然有一汪碧绿的潭水，海面上的圆月经过石壁的折射，在水面中居然出现了三个月亮的奇观。
‘这水潭里面有古怪！
’看着水潭中的三个月亮，隋缘心中忽然闪过这样的念头。
抬眼向上看去，却是只有月白色的石壁与微微晃动的竹叶，刚才那道人影却是早已不见了踪影。
看着上方光滑的石壁，隋缘清楚自己是没有那个实力上去一探究竟的。
回过神，隋缘却有些惊讶的发现，此时水中倒映出来的三个月亮，其中两个正在逐渐的变淡。
‘难道这水潭中真的有什么秘密不成！
’心中犹豫间，水潭中暗淡下来的月影已经只剩下两道淡淡的白影。
‘拼了！
‘咬了咬牙，隋缘迅速脱下上衣，纵深想着水潭中央三个月亮所围拢出来的区域游去。
落入水中的一瞬，隋缘只感觉一股刺骨的寒意将自己瞬间包围，这滋味，简直比以前冬天的时候穿着单衣饿肚子还要难受。
咬了咬牙，强忍住返回岸上的念头，隋缘滑动双手，开始向水潭深处游去。

以前当乞丐的时候经常要不到东西吃，隋缘便学着下河摸鱼，由此练就了一身不错的水性，此时在水潭中游动，除了潭水有些冰寒之外，并没有其他的不适。
十几个呼吸间，隋缘估摸着自己已经向下游了五丈左右的深度了，然而仍旧没有看到水潭的底部。
看着下面幽深的水面，饶是隋缘向来胆子不小，此刻也感觉有些害怕。
就在隋缘犹豫着要不要就此返回的时候，眼角的余光忽然瞥见一侧的水面下闪过了一抹微微的亮光。
蓦然回头，隋缘却只见到一道幽暗的身影一闪而过，瞬间便没入了眼前的黑暗中。
没有多想，隋缘立即挥动手臂跟了上去。
几个呼吸后，隋缘胸中所储存的空气已然快要消耗殆尽，眼前却豁然出现了一个圆形的洞口。
洞口宽不过一尺，只能允许一个身形瘦小的中年人穿过，隋缘眼看着之前那道幽影窜进了眼前的洞口中，来不及犹豫，同样纵身游了进去。
如游鱼一般通过洞口，向前游了不过十几丈远，隋缘感觉到周围的水面开始变得宽阔了起来，向上猛地一纵身，脑袋探出水面，隋缘这才发现自己进入到了一处地下暗河之中。
此刻的隋缘已经分不清楚东南西北，只能沿着与水流相反的方向慢慢游动，好在这地下暗河中并没有憋闷的感觉，想来是与外面有通道相连的。
河道两侧的石壁上长着一些发光的植物，倒也不用担心太黑看不清路。
向前游了没多久，借着石壁上盈盈的光亮，隋缘忽然看到一侧的石壁上有着人工雕琢的痕迹。

Cave in the wall
On Yingxia Island, as the full moon on the sea rose higher and higher, Sui Yuan suddenly stood up from the handrail of the stone pavilion, staring at the stone wall on one side with a look of surprise and uncertainty on his face.
Sui Yuan was certain that a figure had just jumped down from the stone pavilion on the stone wall. This figure did not fall on the ground, but disappeared strangely when it was halfway down.
‘There is something strange on this stone wall!
'This thought flashed through his mind, and Sui Yuan had an uncontrollable desire to go and find out.
‘With that man’s skill, I’m definitely no match for him. As long as I’m careful, there should be no problem!
'The little beggar was not afraid of this statement. He made up his mind and looked around to make sure no one noticed him. Then he tiptoed towards the stone wall.
After walking through the bamboo forest for nearly half an hour, when Sui Yuan arrived panting under the stone wall, he discovered that there was a pool of turquoise water. The full moon on the sea was refracted by the stone wall, and the spectacle of three moons actually appeared in the water.
‘There is something strange in this pool!
’ Looking at the three moons in the pool, Sui Yuan suddenly had this thought in his mind.
Looking up, there were only moon-white stone walls and slightly swaying bamboo leaves, but the figure just now had long since disappeared.
Looking at the smooth stone wall above, Sui Yuan knew that he did not have the strength to go up and find out.
After coming back to his senses, Sui Yuan was a little surprised to find that two of the three moons reflected in the water were gradually fading.
‘Is there really any secret in this pool?
’ While hesitating in his heart, the moonlight dimmed in the pool, leaving only two faint white shadows.
‘Fight it!
Gritting his teeth, Sui Yuan quickly took off his shirt and swam in the area surrounded by the three moons in the center of the pool.
The moment he fell into the water, Sui Yuan felt a biting chill instantly surround him. This feeling was even more uncomfortable than wearing single clothes and being hungry in winter.
Gritting his teeth and resisting the thought of returning to the shore, Sui Yuan moved his hands and began to swim deeper into the pool.
When he was a beggar, he often couldn't get anything to eat, so Sui Yuan learned to fish in the river, thus developing good water skills. Now when he swam in the pool, he felt no other discomfort except that the water was a bit cold.
In a dozen breaths, Sui Yuan estimated that he had swam down about five feet, but he still could not see the bottom of the pool.
Looking at the deep water below, Sui Yuan felt a little scared even though he had always been very timid.
Just when Sui Yuan was hesitating whether to return, from the corner of his eye, he suddenly caught a glimpse of a faint light flashing under the water on one side.
Suddenly turning around, Sui Yuan only saw a dark figure flashing past, and instantly disappeared into the darkness in front of him.
Without thinking much, Sui Yuan immediately waved his arms and followed.
After a few breaths, the air stored in Sui Yuan's chest was almost exhausted, but a circular hole suddenly appeared in front of him.
The hole was only one foot wide, and could only allow a thin middle-aged man to pass through. Sui Yuan saw the shadow from before rushing into the hole in front of him, and without any time to hesitate, he swam in as well.
He passed through the hole like a fish and swam forward no more than a dozen feet. Sui Yuan felt that the surrounding water began to become wider. He jumped upwards and stuck his head out of the water. Only then did Sui Yuan realize that he had entered an underground river.
At this moment, Sui Yuan could no longer tell the difference between east, west and north, so he could only swim slowly in the opposite direction to the current. Fortunately, there was no feeling of suffocation in the underground river. It must be connected to a passage outside.
There are some luminous plants growing on the stone walls on both sides of the river, so you don’t have to worry about it being too dark to see the road.
Swimming forwardNot long after, Sui Yuan suddenly saw traces of artificial carvings on the stone wall on one side through the light shining on the stone wall.
